This design has the MAXI cache enabled for port reconstruct/fullImage, which is accessed after the first II clock cycles, i.e. after the ap_ready signal of the top function has been set to 1. Therefore, pipelining of this top function needs to be done with care since the cache is cleared only when the top function is done (ap_done set to 1), and not when it is ready for a new invocation (ap_ready set to 1). So, any pipelined calls of the top function can result in the stale cache being read instead of the new cache, potentially leading to inaccurate data processing.
